# Instagram Close Friends BOT

> Mass-add all your Instagram followers into your Close Friends list — grant visibility to your stories and boost engagement.

This project uses Selenium with mobile emulation to automate the addition of followers to the Close Friends list. It is currently in BETA and intended for research purposes.
